context_events_since_previous_candidate.text_excerpt: This definition has the following drawback. Suppose that $k'/k$ is an extension of fields. Suppose that $X$ is a variety over $k$. Then the base change $X_{k'} = X \times_{\Spec(k)} \Spec(k')$ is not necessarily a variety over $k'$. This phenomenon (in greater generality) will be discussed in detail in the following sections. The product of two varieties need not be a variety (this is really the same phenomenon). Here is an example.
